The Ministry of Science and ICT and the state-run Korea Institute of Science and Technology Information (KISTI) marked the launch Monday at KISTI headquarters in Daejeon, the nation’s primary scientific and research hub located about 140 kilometers south of Seoul. The ceremony brought together roughly 200 leaders from across industry, academia and government research institutions. Constructed at a cost of 382.5 billion won ($276 million), Hangang replaces Nurion, the fifth-generation supercomputer deployed in 2018. Nurion ranked 11th globally at launch and supported 1,730 research projects over its eight-year lifespan. Those efforts produced 1,520 peer-reviewed papers, including 70 published in top-tier international journals such as Nature, Science and Cell. The Supreme Court finalized Akmal's life imprisonment in 2010 on charges of robbing and killing a 50-something taxi driver in Changwon in March 2009. After his first request for a retrial was rejected in 2015, he filed a second petition in January last year through Park Jun-young, a defense attorney known for handling retrial cases. Park pointed out numerous flaws in the original investigation, including forensic opinions on the victim's neck wounds, taxi routes, records from the National Forensic Service, phone logs and testimony regarding the weapon. Korea Customs Service Commissioner Lee Jong-wook met with Mitsuhiro Teraoka, director-general of Japan's Customs and Tariff Bureau, in Tokyo last week to discuss three areas of cooperation, the customs agency said Monday. Korea proposed closer enforcement cooperation between the two countries' customs authorities and asked Japan to help Korean companies use its system for requesting customs authorities to block imports and exports of goods suspected of infringing intellectual property rights. The service begins Monday at 188 diplomatic missions, according to the Overseas Koreans Agency, the Korean National Police Agency and the Korea Road Traffic Authority (KoROAD). Korea has two ordinary license classes. A Class 1 license covers larger vehicles, such as trucks of up to 12 tons. A Class 2 license is mainly for passenger cars. Diplomatic missions have handled driver’s license paperwork since 2013. Until now, they could only renew Class 2 licenses and reissue lost or damaged ones, because Class 1 renewals require an aptitude test that includes an eye exam. Under the new system, Class 1 licenses will be renewed in Korea if the applicant has a domestic health checkup or physical exam on record from the past two years. Outside regular operating hours, foreign residents can access alternative support networks, such as the government-backed Danuri Call Center, which assists multicultural families and international residents. The top court published the outcome of the survey conducted on 360 judges from Oct. 6-16 as it sought to examine increasingly worrisome cases of "AI hallucination" — a term referring to a situation where AI models present false information as if they were true. Its shelves are packed with English-language books at discount prices, and visitors are invited not only to browse and buy, but also to exchange books and meet fellow readers. The Welcome to Our Warehouse (WOW) Family Sale, organized by English-language book distributor dbBOOKS, returns this Saturday and Sunday with its familiar mix of warehouse bargains and community events. This year's program includes a book talk with award-winning Korean novelist You-jeong Jeong, author of "Bonobo," which was recently published in English translation, as well as a book swap. For dbBOOKS, the sale has turned into something more than just a way to move books off warehouse shelves. The company operates as a wholesaler, importer, distributor and retailer, supplying books to major Korean online and physical retailers. In total, the stipends amounted to 905.8 million won, starting at 171.5 million won in 2020. The ministry reiterated its rejection of all violations that threaten the security and safety of maritime navigation and global energy supplies. “The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia affirms its solidarity with the State of Qatar in all the measures it takes to protect its maritime vessels and ensure the safety of its international trade. It stresses the importance of the international community taking urgent measures to ensure maritime security and the safety of international trade, and to enforce international law in this regard,” the foreign ministry said.

items.title: Saudi Arabia’s first robot-assisted breast reconstruction surgery successful
items.title_zh: 沙特阿拉伯首例机器人辅助乳房重建手术成功
items.summary: RIYADH — The Ministry of Interior’s Medical Services, represented by Security Forces Hospital in Riyadh, has successfully performed the first breast reconstruction surgery of its kind in the Kingdom using robotic surgical technology. The procedure was performed on a 43-year-old woman who had previously undergone a nipple- and skin-sparing mastectomy following a breast cancer diagnosis. The procedure was carried out by a specialized medical team using robotic-assisted breast reconstruction techniques. The surgery involved harvesting skin and fatty tissue from the abdominal area and transferring them to the chest using microsurgical techniques. This highly delicate procedure is traditionally performed through conventional surgical methods and requires a specialized medical team and meticulous planning. The robotic technology used in the procedure offers the advantage of preserving the integrity of the abdominal wall through a minimally invasive approach involving very small incisions. This helps reduce the risk of complications associated with conventional surgery, particularly hernias and abdominal bulging, while enhancing surgical precision. Breast reconstruction procedures hold significant medical and psychological importance for women who have undergone mastectomies due to cancer. These procedures play a vital role in improving quality of life, promoting psychological well-being, and restoring self-confidence, ultimately contributing positively to patients’ overall health. This achievement reflects the advancement in the adoption and application of modern surgical technologies. It also represents a continuation of the Ministry of Interior’s Medical Services’ efforts to embrace the latest medical and surgical innovations, advance specialized healthcare services, and enhance the efficiency and quality of care provided to beneficiaries.

items.title: Saudi, Japanese FMs underscore international cooperation to ensure freedom of navigation

The meetingwas held on the sidelines of the G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting. During their meeting, Prince Faisal and Motegi reviewed Saudi-Japanese relations. They discussed regional developments, particularly the continued attacks by the Houthi militia on Saudi territory. Both sides condemned the attacks and expressed solidarity in addressing current regional challenges. The ministers also examined threats to shipping in the Strait of Hormuz and the Bab Al-Mandab Strait and their impact on energy security, trade, and global supply chains. They stressed the importance of international cooperation to ensure freedom of navigation and the stability of maritime routes.

items.title: OPEC+ agree to keep oil output quota steady for December

items.summary: RIYADH — The Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries and its allies (OPEC+) agreed to keep their oil output level unchanged for the third consecutive month in December. Seven OPEC+ members — Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Algeria, Kazakhstan and Oman — made the decision in an online meeting on Sunday, OPEC said in a statement. The meeting reviewed global market conditions and outlook. The seven countries reiterated their collective commitment to achieve full conformity with the Declaration of Cooperation. The OPEC+ countries confirmed expectations that more policy adjustments will not occur until next year, as the group continues to struggle with export disruptions from the US-Iran war. "The seven participating countries decided to maintain September 2026 required production for December 2026," the statement noted. In September, the OPEC+ countries decided to maintain the production levels for October 2026 that were set for September 2026. In August, the seven countries had agreed to increase oil production by 188,000 barrels per day (bpd) for September.The seven OPEC+ countries will continue to hold monthly meetings to review market conditions. The next meeting will be held on November 29, 2026.

items.title: Coalition launches precision military strike targeting Houthi war resources in Yemen

items.summary: RIYADH —The Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen carried out a precision military operation Sunday morning to neutralize vital resources used by the Houthi militia to support its war effort, coalition spokesperson Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Malki announced. In a statement issued on Sunday, Al-Malki said the operation followed continued Houthi attacks against civilians and civilian objects in Yemen and Saudi Arabia, alongside threats to maritime shipping lanes in the southern Red Sea. According to the coalition spokesperson, the Houthi militia has continued to exploit vital resources to support its military activities and strengthen its capabilities, particularly its ballistic missile and drone programs. He stated that the operation aimed to neutralize resources used by the militia to carry out repeated attacks and threaten the security of Saudi Arabia, Yemen and maritime navigation in the southern Red Sea. Al-Malki emphasized that the coalition would continue implementing the necessary operational measures to deter Houthi attacks and prevent the militia from using vital resources to sustain its military operations. He also called on the Houthi militia to cease all hostile operations against civilians and civilian objects, warning that it would bear the consequences of continued attacks.

items.summary: JEDDAH — Red and orange weather alerts have been issued across several regions, as dense fog and moderate to heavy thunderstorms are expected to affect several Saudi regions, according to the National Center for Meteorology (NCM). The NCM issued two red alerts for dense fog in parts of the Eastern Province, alongside orange alerts for fog in other parts of the region. Orange alerts for moderate rainfall have also been issued across parts of the Northern Borders, Hail, Makkah, Asir, Al-Baha and Jazan. According to the NCM’s Sunday forecast, moderate to heavy thunderstorms capable of causing flash floods, accompanied by showers of hail, are expected across parts of Jazan, Asir, Al-Baha, Makkah, Madinah, Hail and the Northern Borders. Active surface winds stirring up dust and sand are also forecast over parts of these regions, as well as parts of Riyadh and Al-Qassim. For temperatures, Dammam is forecast to record the highest temperature at 38°C, followed by Makkah at 37°C and Riyadh, Jeddah and Buraidah at 36°C. Madinah and Jazan are expected to reach 35°C, followed by Hail at 31°C, Najran at 30°C, Sakaka at 29°C, Tabuk at 28°C, Arar at 27°C, Abha at 25°C and Al-Baha at 23°C. Humidity is forecast to reach 95 percent in Abha, followed by 90 percent in Dammam, Al-Baha and Arar, and 80 percent in Hail and Sakaka. Jazan is expected to record 75 percent humidity, followed by Jeddah at 70 percent, Makkah at 65 percent, Madinah at 60 percent, Tabuk at 55 percent, Buraidah and Najran at 35 percent, and Riyadh at 30 percent.

items.title: Prince Fahd bin Jalawi represents Saudi Crown Prince at Dakar 2026 Youth Olympics opening ceremony
items.title_zh: 法赫德·本·贾拉维亲王代表沙特王储出席2026年达喀尔青年奥运会开幕式
items.summary: DAKAR — On behalf of Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, Prince Fahd bin Jalawi, Vice President of the Saudi Olympic and Paralympic Committee, attended the opening ceremony of the fourth Youth Olympic Games. The ceremony, held on October 31 at Abdoulaye Wade Stadium in Diamniadio, Senegal, was attended by Senegalese President Bassirou Diomaye Faye, International Olympic Committee (IOC) President Kirsty Coventry and several heads of state. **media[2788001]** The opening ceremony featured artistic and cultural performances showcasing Senegal’s history and heritage, alongside displays reflecting the values of the Olympic movement and the spirit of determination and perseverance. The event also included official addresses by the IOC President and organizing committee officials, followed by a parade of participating delegations. Prince Fahd expressed his gratitude to the Saudi leadership for its continued support of the Kingdom’s sports sector, which he said has contributed to significant advances in Saudi sports and strengthened the Kingdom’s presence at international sporting events. **media[2788000]** He highlighted the importance of Saudi Arabia’s participation in the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games, describing it as an opportunity for young Saudi athletes to gain Olympic experience, improve their technical performance and represent the Kingdom on the global stage. Prince Fahd also wished the participating Saudi athletes success, expressing hope that they would deliver outstanding performances and achieve positive results. **media[2788003]**
